params.name: q
params.description: Search query string. Supports search operators including exact phrase matching (quotes), term exclusion (minus), site-specific search (site:), and file type filtering (filetype:).

params.name: country
params.description: 2-character country code for geographic targeting (e.g. US, GB, DE).

params.name: search_lang
params.description: ISO 639-1 language code for content language preference (e.g. en, es, fr).

params.name: ui_lang
params.description: Language code for response metadata and UI strings.

params.name: count
params.description: Number of results per page. Maximum is 20.

params.name: safesearch
params.description: Safe search content filtering level. Options: off, moderate (default), or strict.

params.name: freshness
params.description: Date-based freshness filter. Use pd (past 24 hours), pw (past week), pm (past month), py (past year), or a custom date range in the format YYYY-MM-DDtoYYYY-MM-DD.

params.name: extra_snippets
params.description: When true, returns up to 5 additional text excerpts per result.

params.name: enable_rich_callback
params.description: Enable rich data enrichments. Set to 1 to enable rich result callbacks for verticals like weather, stocks, sports, and more.

items.docs: Search across billions of indexed web pages with fast, reliable results. Supports search operators, geographic targeting, language filtering, date freshness, safe search controls, and rich data enrichments across 20+ verticals.

params.name: callback_key
params.description: Callback key from the rich field of a web search response.

items.docs: Retrieve rich result data for a specific vertical using a callback key obtained from a web search response. Supports weather, stocks, sports scores, currency, cryptocurrency, and more.
